payload.body_they: {{Name}} may do some of their clearest thinking in private, especially when an important decision needs time to remain unfinished before anyone else needs an answer. Family phrases about money, success, responsibility, or relationships can stay with them for years. Understanding where those ideas came from gives them context, but it does not require them to keep building around them. The past is most useful when it gives them more choice about what they accept now.
